_comment: OBSERVED `tools/list` output of the BioMCP sidecar (DEC-10 / ITEM-28).
`bio_mcp/handlers.rs` is a PURE reverse proxy — no tool name exists in-tree; the
names arrive from the external sidecar at runtime. So this fixture is the ONLY
in-repo source of truth for the bio tool surface, and the frontend rail
derived from it. Any name NOT listed here degrades to a name-only rail row
(ITEM-6), which is the same behaviour as before this fixture existed.
Re-probe and re-commit this file after a `BIOMCP_VERSION` bump.

probe.binary: ~/.ziee/bin/biomcp (29327360 bytes — a REAL binary, not a fail-soft stub)
probe.transport: MCP streamable HTTP, POST /mcp (initialize -> notifications/initialized -> tools/list)
notes: tools/list returned exactly ONE tool. The whole ~45-database surface is
reached through a single CLI-shaped `command` string.
Two live tools/call probes (`list`, and the networked `get gene BRAF`) both
returned `structuredContent: null` — the sidecar answers in the TEXT channel
only. The rail contribution therefore derives its detail from the tool_use
